description: This file exports ONNX operators for opset 16, including new and updated operators such as GridSample, scatter_add, and scatter_reduce, with functions defining symbolic representations for ONNX export.

methods.name: grid_sampler
methods.description: Defines the symbolic representation for the ONNX GridSample operator, handling 4D inputs and interpolation/padding modes.

methods.name: scatter_add
methods.description: Defines the symbolic representation for the ONNX scatter_add operator, supporting tensor shape adjustments and type casting.

methods.name: scatter_reduce
methods.description: Defines the symbolic representation for the ONNX scatter_reduce operator, supporting reduction modes and handling zero-rank tensors.
